title: The assembled operations on their proved domains
statement:
The seven clauses of [prop-functor-package] apply to the global
finite-field datum. Their domains and hypotheses are retained verbatim:
the dimension-free internal-Hom bound uses a site-perfect first
variable. General Hom coefficient comparison and exceptional adjunction
hold on the constructible domains proved in the package. General
Verdier biduality at all four coefficient stages is
[thm-sf-biduality-class]; finite coefficients use $D^b_{ctf}$,
and the integral and field stages use the specified $D^b_c$.

proof.text: Identify the global finite-field setting with the datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]: the geometric base is the fixed algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, the prime $\ell$ differs from $p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, and $n\geq1$. The coefficient stages are $A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$, with exactly the completion, rationalization and common-stage conventions of that datum. Take the separated finite-type schemes and morphisms, and the operations named there. This only identifies the parameters and notation; it makes no claim about preservation or existence beyond the cited datum.

source.place: Apply the terminal assembly: identification of its parameters; operation datum, opening paragraph and clauses 1–5

proof.text: Apply [prop-functor-package] to these same parameters. Its clauses (1)–(7), without changing any objects or transformations, give respectively coefficient extension and descent, compactification and reduction comparisons, compact-support composition and localization, base change, the compact-support projection isomorphism, smooth purity, and Verdier exchange with exceptional adjunction. The preceding paragraph of that proposition also gives general internal-Hom coefficient comparison and constructible preservation. Retain its finite-stage $D^b_{ctf}$ domain and its specified integral/field $D^b_c$ domains. In particular the dimension-free Hom bound retains a site-perfect first argument; ordinary base change retains the proper-$f$ or smooth-$g$ alternative, torsion bounded-below finite coefficients, and adic constructible higher coefficients. The projection formula retains the finite-Tor condition on its second factor, smooth purity retains its stated admissible domains, and exceptional adjunction is the constructible adjunction stated in the package. Thus all seven clauses and the additional Hom assertions in the present statement are direct instances of the existing package; none is reproved using this export.

source.place: Entire proof: Apply the terminal assembly [prop-functor-package]; package opening domain paragraph and clauses 1–7

proof.text: For the explicitly named biduality conclusion, apply [thm-sf-biduality-class] to a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$ and each of the four coefficient stages just fixed. Its dualizing object is $Ra_X^!\Lambda$ and its dual is $R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,Ra_X^!\Lambda)$, the same operations as in the datum and in clause (7) of the package. It states the exact contravariant anti-equivalence and the natural evaluation-defined isomorphism $K\longrightarrow D_{X,\Lambda}D_{X,\Lambda}K$. At $A_{E,n}$ take its $D^b_{ctf}$ domain; at $\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$ take the whole specified $D^b_c$ domain, exactly as that theorem says. This supplies the last sentence of the present statement without adding a site-perfect hypothesis to general biduality or enlarging any other clause.
